footprint_m.note: OSM way 165563981 is the whole Campus de Gualtar (amenity=university, 40.2 ha). Parts in footprints.json: 102 buildings (every OSM building inside the campus, including the old farmhouses along the lane on the west side), 4 pitches, 3 gardens, 5 water features, 194 footpaths and the Prometeu sculpture. The whole campus is exclude_outline: false, but all its buildings are parts, so buildings.json no longer draws any of them: the model must draw every building part.
